title: Extend the argument parser
prompt: The command-line argument parser in this project (`parseArgs(argv, schema)`) only understands `--name value` and boolean flags. Extend it as described in README.md: `--name=value`, `--no-flag`, short options and combined short flags, `--` as the end of options, repeatable options, number options, and errors for unknown or invalid options. Existing behaviour must stay. Run the tests with `npm test`.
